lines: 我又看见一个新天新地；
因为先前的天地已经过去了，
海也不再有了。
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were gone; and there was no more sea.
我又看见且听见，
宝座与活物并长老的周围有许多天使的声音；
他们的数目有千千万万，
And I saw
and there came to my ears the sound of a great number of angels round about the high seat and the beasts and the rulers; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand
and thousands of thousands;
这样，我在你们中间，
因你与我彼此的信心，
就可以同得安慰。
That is to say
that all of us may be comforted together by the faith which is in you and in me.
你若口里认耶稣为主，
心里信神叫他从死里复活，
就必得救。
Because
if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord
and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead
you will have salvation:
你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信神叫他从死里复活，就必得救。
因为人心里相信，就可以称义；口里承认，就可以得救。
Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:
For with the heart man has faith to get righteousness, and with the mouth he says that Jesus is Lord to get salvation.
所以弟兄们，我以神的慈悲劝你们，将身体献上，当作活祭，是圣洁的，是神所喜悦的；你们如此事奉乃是理所当然的。
不要效法这个世界，只要心意更新而变化，叫你们察验何为神的善良、纯全、可喜悦的旨意。

For this reason I make request to you, brothers, by the mercies of God, that you will give your bodies as a living offering, holy, pleasing to God, which is the worship it is right for you to give him.
And let not your behaviour be like that of this world, but be changed and made new in mind, so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.
爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；
恭敬人，要彼此推让。
Be kind to one another with a brother's love
putting others before yourselves in honour;
在指望中要喜乐，
在患难中要忍耐，
祷告要恒切。
Being glad in hope
quiet in trouble
at all times given to prayer
与喜乐的人要同乐；
与哀哭的人要同哭。
Take part in the joy of those who are glad
and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.
若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
As far as it is possible for you be at peace with all men.
不要效法这个世界，
只要心意更新而变化，
叫你们察验何为神的善良、纯全、可喜悦的旨意。
And let not your behaviour be like that of this world
but be changed and made new in mind
so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.
所以，「你的仇敌若饿了，就给他吃，若渴了，就给他喝；因为你这样行就是把炭火堆在他的头上。」
你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
But if one who has hate for you is in need of food or of drink, give it to him, for in so doing you will put coals of fire on his head.
Do not let evil overcome you, but overcome evil by good.
正如我们一个身子上有好些肢体，肢体也不都是一样的用处。
我们这许多人，在基督里成为一身，互相联络作肢体，也是如此。
For, as we have a number of parts in one body, but all the parts have not the same use,
So we, though we are a number of persons, are one body in Christ, and are dependent on one another;
但愿使人有盼望的神，
因信将诸般的喜乐、平安充满你们的心，
使你们借着圣灵的能力大有盼望。
Now may the God of hope make you full of joy and peace through faith
so that all hope may be yours in the power of the Holy Spirit.
我们既因信称义，
就借着我们的主耶稣基督得与神相和。
For which reason
because we have righteousness through faith
let us be at peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；
因为知道患难生忍耐，
And not only so
but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;
不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，
忍耐生老练，老练生盼望；
And not only so, but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;
And waiting gives experience; and experience, hope:
因我们还软弱的时候，
基督就按所定的日期为罪人死。
For when we were still without strength
at the right time Christ gave his life for evil-doers.
况且我们的软弱有圣灵帮助，我们本不晓得当怎样祷告，只是圣灵亲自用说不出来的叹息替我们祷告。
鉴察人心的，晓得圣灵的意思，因为圣灵照着神的旨意替圣徒祈求。

And in the same way the Spirit is a help to our feeble hearts: for we are not able to make prayer to God in the right way; but the Spirit puts our desires into words which are not in our power to say;
And he who is the searcher of hearts has knowledge of the mind of the Spirit, because he is making prayers for the saints in agreement with the mind of God.
我们晓得万事都互相效力，
叫爱神的人得益处，
就是按他旨意被召的人。
And we are conscious that all things are working together for good to those who have love for God
and have been marked out by his purpose.
